{
  "conventions": [
    "Every new .ts, .tsx, or .js file must start with the 2026 Apache-2.0 license header (Copyright 2026 The Backstage Authors); never alter the copyright year in existing files.",
    "Formatting uses Prettier with singleQuote: true, trailingComma: 'all', arrowParens: 'avoid', and 80-column print width.",
    "Public exports in @backstage/* packages must carry TSDoc comments with a release tag (@public or @alpha) and stay in sync with each package's report*.api.md file.",
    "Frontend user-facing strings must be registered in the plugin's createTranslationRef messages object (catalogTranslationRef in plugins/catalog/src/alpha/translation.ts and techdocsTranslationRef in plugins/techdocs/src/translation.ts) and read with useTranslationRef.",
    "Tests use Jest and @testing-library/react with renderInTestApp and TestApiProvider from @backstage/test-utils."
  ],
  "decisions": [
    {
      "topic": "Former-names annotation constant, syntax, and validation",
      "choice": "Export @public ANNOTATION_FORMER_NAMES = 'backstage.io/former-names' from @backstage/catalog-model; value is a comma-separated list of entity names or references ([<kind>:][<namespace>/]<name>) resolved against the declaring entity's own kind and metadata.namespace (or 'default'), restricted to the same kind and excluding self-references.",

        "Dedicated metadata.formerNames array field on the Entity envelope",
        "Allowing cross-kind former-name claims"

      "reason": "Well-known annotations require no Entity schema migration, and restricting claims to the same kind prevents cross-kind URL hijacking."
